module purpose: neorv32_cpu_decompressor is purely combinational: it reads a 16-bit compressed instruction on instr_i, expands it in one process (lines 52-296) into a 32-bit instruction word held in decoded, and drives that word on instr_o, forcing bit 1 of instr_o to '0' when the process classifies the input as illegal (line 300).

use-case flows.value: the 16-bit compressed instruction from instr_i expanded field by field into a 32-bit instruction word and delivered on instr_o
the illegal-encoding decision on the compressed input, reported to the consumer by forcing instr_o bit 1 to '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Decompressed instruction word -- the 32-bit instruction the module computes from the 16-bit compressed input and delivers to its consumer
conceptual assets.reasoning: The expansion flow picks the format with `case instr_i(ci_opcode_msb_c downto ci_opcode_lsb_c) is` (line 65) and the funct3 cases (lines 68, 106, 211), then places input fields at fixed positions of decoded, e.g. `decoded(instr_rd_msb_c downto instr_rd_lsb_c) <= "01" & instr_i(ci_rd_3_msb_c downto ci_rd_3_lsb_c);` (line 74) and the jump immediate built from the process variable imm20_v (lines 57, 116). `instr_o(31 downto 2) <= decoded(31 downto 2);` (line 299) and `instr_o(0) <= decoded(0);` (line 301) deliver it. The consumer of instr_o is not in the supplied RTL, so Integrity is Established from the delivering lines 299-301: the consumer must receive exactly the word the selected branch defines; a wrong field mapping changes the register, immediate or operation fields of the delivered word. Process order is part of the definition: the default `decoded <= x"00000003";` (line 62) is overwritten by later branch assignments, and line 146 overwrites the rd field written at line 144 in the same branch. Availability is also Established in a bounded sense: the process is sensitive to instr_i (line 52) and the default at line 62 drives every bit on every path, so instr_o is defined for every input; no timing beyond that is assumed. Confidentiality is not established: no line restricts who observes instr_i or instr_o. Roles: instr_i sets, read here to compute the word (SOURCES decoded, occurrence 18, line 74; it also SELECTS decoded at line 65); decoded computes the word (DERIVES_FROM instr_i, occurrence 5, line 74, plus SELECTED_BY instr_i records for each branch); instr_o is the exit port (DERIVES_FROM decoded, occurrence 2, line 299). decoded is combinational with no COPIES record, so the copy rule does not remove it. imm20_v and imm12_v are process variables, not candidates. instr_i is a plain 16-bit vector, not a transport record, and drives no SEQUENCES or RESETS.

conceptual assets.concept: Illegal-encoding decision -- whether the compressed input is an encoding the decompressor rejects, reported by clearing bit 1 of the delivered word
conceptual assets.reasoning: illegal defaults to '0' (line 61) and is driven to '1' only under specific predicates on instr_i: `if (instr_i(12 downto 5) = "00000000") then` / `illegal <= '1';` (lines 77-78), the unmatched funct3 arms (lines 100, 291), and the field checks at lines 153-154, 180-181, 203-204, 221-222, 232-234, 245-246, 256-258 and 266-267. `instr_o(1) <= decoded(1) when (illegal = '0') else '0';` (line 300) reports the decision to the consumer. Integrity is Established: the decision must be '1' exactly for those predicates, and a wrong value either lets a rejected encoding leave with bit 1 taken from decoded (default '1' from line 62) or clears bit 1 of an accepted word; the consumer of instr_o is not supplied, so it must receive exactly the qualification line 300 defines. illegal is an error flag computed here, so it computes (GATED_BY instr_i, occurrence 3, line 78; also SELECTED_BY instr_i at the same occurrence); every driver is a literal, which is why the flow graph lists it as a CONTROL-ONLY constant-valued source gating instr_o, and the RTL agrees. instr_i sets, as the input this entity reads to decide (GATES illegal, occurrence 23, line 77). instr_o is the exit port (GATED_BY illegal, occurrence 3, line 300). decoded is not listed for this concept: it carries the data bit that the decision gates, not the decision. Availability: the default at line 61 defines the flag on every path for every input. Confidentiality is not established.
